title.zh: 特朗普对伊朗发动“经济战”，威胁制裁任何贸易伙伴
title.en: Trump threatens economic isolation for Iran and its trading partners

desc.zh: 在军事打击与海上封锁未能迫使伊朗屈服后，特朗普宣布对伊朗实施“前所未有的经济战与孤立”，威胁制裁任何向伊朗提供“生命线”的金融机构、企业与政府；阿联酋已暂停与伊朗的全部贸易与金融往来。
desc.en: After military strikes and a maritime blockade failed to force Tehran to capitulate, Trump announced “economic warfare and isolation on an unprecedented scale,” threatening sanctions on any bank, business or government providing a “lifeline” to Iran; the UAE has suspended all trade and financial dealings with Tehran.

title.zh: 长和对巴拿马启动国际仲裁，索赔逾15亿美元
title.en: CK Hutchison seeks $1.5 billion from Panama in arbitration

desc.zh: 长和已就巴尔博亚港、克里斯托瓦尔港码头被接管一事，对巴拿马启动投资条约仲裁，索赔逾15亿美元；公司称逾6个月磋商中对方从未提出赔偿方案。
desc.en: CK Hutchison launched investment-treaty arbitration against Panama seeking over $1.5 billion over the loss of the Balboa and Cristóbal terminals; it says six months of consultations produced no compensation offer.

title.zh: 跨太平洋集装箱运价连续上涨，船公司削减运力
title.en: Transpacific container rates surge as carriers cut capacity

desc.zh: 德鲁里世界集装箱指数（WCI）连续第二周上涨，上海—纽约、上海—洛杉矶现货运价周涨约 9%；船公司以空班、削减 8 月运力（美东环比 -9%）托底运价，9 月起还将加收巴拿马运河附加费。
desc.en: Drewry's World Container Index rose for a second straight week, with Shanghai–New York and Shanghai–Los Angeles spot rates up ~9% on the week; carriers are propping up rates with blank sailings and an ~9% month-on-month cut in August US East Coast capacity, with Panama Canal surcharges due from September.

title.zh: 巴拿马运河通行费创纪录，催生 LPG 船对船转运
title.en: Soaring Panama Canal fees drive a nascent LPG shuttle trade

desc.zh: 巴拿马运河拥堵与创纪录通行费（大型船闸单次插队费一度达 460 万美元）正倒逼雪佛龙等出口商用“小船过河 + 船对船转运”的方式，把美国 LPG 运往亚洲，绕开天价过河成本。
desc.en: Congestion and record transit fees — a single Neopanamax priority slot hit $4.6 million — are pushing exporters including Chevron toward “small vessel through the canal + ship-to-ship transfer” to move US LPG to Asia, sidestepping punitive canal costs.

title.zh: 亚丁湾一艘油轮遭武装人员劫持，被驶向索马里
title.en: Sanctioned shadow-fleet tanker hijacked in Gulf of Aden, diverted toward Somalia

desc.zh: 英国海上贸易行动办公室（UKMTO）证实，一艘在也门穆卡拉以东约136海里处西行的油轮被6名武装人员登船控制，并被驶向索马里方向；这是近期第二起类似事件，当局正在调查。
desc.en: UKMTO confirmed six armed men boarded a westbound tanker about 136 nm east of Mukalla, Yemen, took control and set course toward Somalia — the second such incident. Authorities are investigating.

title.zh: 三艘中国关联油轮在霍尔木兹海峡掉头
title.en: Three Chinese tankers U-turn in Hormuz as risks remain high

desc.zh: 三艘中国关联超大型油轮（Sea V、Hestia、Erecter）在霍尔木兹海峡附近相继掉头，袭击风险持续高企；海峡可见通行量降至冰点，布伦特原油一度站上 91 美元。
desc.en: Three China-linked VLCCs (Sea V, Hestia, Erecter) reversed course in or near the Strait of Hormuz as attack risks stay elevated; visible traffic has slowed to a trickle and Brent moved above $91.

title.zh: 赫伯罗特收购以星遭多方抵制，巴西启动全面反垄断审查
title.en: Growing pushback against more liner consolidation a threat to Hapag-Zim deal

desc.zh: 货代行业声援巴西监管机构与以色列立法者的质疑；巴西已就三条重叠航线对赫伯罗特收购以星（Zim）启动全面反垄断审查。这是班轮业进一步整合遭遇的最新阻力。
desc.en: Forwarders have backed objections from Brazilian authorities and Israeli legislators over Hapag-Lloyd's takeover of Zim; Brazil has opened a full antitrust review over overlapping service routes. Fresh pushback against further liner consolidation.

title.zh: 加什么？资深仓储运营商的押注方向
title.en: What to Add: Where Experienced Warehouse Operators are Placing their Bets

desc.zh: 拥有近百年合计经验的一线仓储老兵分享正在试点的方向：叉车驾驶辅助、以整条流程为单位的集成规划（替代单点优化）与低成本数字孪生模拟；到 2028 年，人力将更多转向“异常处理经理”角色。
desc.en: Warehouse veterans with nearly a century of combined experience share what they are actively piloting: forklift driver assist, integrated flow-level planning over point solutions, and low-cost digital twins — with humans shifting toward “exception manager” roles by 2028.

title.zh: 供应链断裂时，货运科技如何应答：2021—2023 加速之年
title.en: When the Supply Chain Broke, Freight Tech Answered: The 2021 to 2023 Acceleration Years

desc.zh: 疫情危机用 18 个月完成了十年销售话术没能做到的事：货运撮合、实时可视化和自动化从“可选”变成“基础设施”。回顾这一品类如何永久重置了行业对货运科技的期待。
desc.en: The pandemic crisis did in 18 months what a decade of sales pitches could not: digital freight matching, real-time visibility and automation moved from optional to essential infrastructure. A retrospective on how the category permanently reset industry expectations.

title.zh: 仓库效率的未来：将 AI 应用于 WMS 实施
title.en: The Future of Warehouse Efficiency: Applying AI to WMS Implementations

desc.zh: 将 AI 嵌入 WMS 实施方法论（配置标准、集成规则、测试脚本）可缩短交付周期、降低技术债。关键模式是把 AI 当作“副驾驶”，在治理框架内由人验证其产出。
desc.en: AI embedded in WMS implementation methodology — configuration standards, integration rules, testing scripts — shortens delivery cycles and reduces technical debt. The winning pattern: AI as a copilot within governance frameworks, with humans validating outputs.

title.zh: 亚马逊与仓储科技公司 AutoStore 达成全球供应协议
title.en: Amazon, fulfillment tech company AutoStore ink global supply deal

desc.zh: 这份不含采购承诺的协议，为电商巨头的履约自动化布局再添一块拼图。
desc.en: The agreement — which carries no purchase commitments — adds to the e-commerce giant's push to automate fulfillment.

title.zh: 菜鸟在 APEC 对话会力推 AI 关务与机器人仓储
title.en: Cainiao touts AI customs clearance and robot warehouses at APEC forum

desc.zh: 菜鸟 CEO 万霖在大连 APEC 海关与商界对话会上表示，其 AI 关务系统可将单票清关时长压缩 80%，未来将在多个 APEC 经济体投资建设机器人仓储；今年已在欧洲新开 7 座海外仓。
desc.en: At the APEC customs–business dialogue in Dalian, Cainiao CEO Wan Lin said its AI customs system cuts per-shipment clearance time by 80% and that it will build robot warehouses across multiple APEC economies; it has opened seven new overseas warehouses in Europe this year.

title.zh: 亚马逊今年将无人机配送覆盖范围扩大六倍
title.en: Amazon to expand drone delivery reach sixfold this year

desc.zh: Prime Air 无人机配送将很快落地亚特兰大、芝加哥、克利夫兰都市圈，今年配送覆盖范围将扩大六倍。
desc.en: Prime Air will soon launch in metro Atlanta, Chicago and Cleveland — a sixfold expansion of drone delivery reach this year.
